newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heineken jumps at open after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Heineken jumps at open after 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Dutch brewer Heineken NV jumped at the Amsterdam bourse open on Friday after the company reported 1996 net profits of 655 million guilders, against a consensus forecast of around 647 million.
The shares opened up 8.00 guilders at 337.50 continuing a rise started Thursday when they gained 12.30 guilders to 329.50.
Heineken said it saw profit growth in 1997, but couldn't yet quantify how much.
"The results were a little better than we had expected," an analyst said. "They were a little bit cautious with the prospects, but that was expected."
